scope_guards: Local housing need is an unconstrained minimum starting point and is not an adopted housing requirement.
Housing Delivery Test and five-year housing land supply are backward-looking and forward-looking measures respectively.
The latest published national HDT measurement is retained; unpublished later results are not inferred.
Authority-level HDT consequences do not create or remove parcel permission.
Five-year supply buffers are conditional and are not cumulative.
The 1 July 2026 buffer transition is applied only where all stated authority-level criteria are evidenced.
Published local-plan housing requirement is not site capacity, title, permission or delivery evidence.
No score or promotion is written without current authority result, current supply evidence and candidate-specific planning and delivery evidence.
